name: Krais Lir Lanahime
original_name: クライス・リル・ラナハイム
source: Kreis inherited throne when he was very young and from that time on he focuses on development of military power, magic and technology. He is constantly looking for a chance to change low status of his kingdom that is not eve recognized as proper country. Now finally after long time of lying low, golden opportunity arises. Not much to say about him unless spoiler for the story, King of Lanahime Kingdom, takes great pride and looks up to his sister.
